name: Húszashívásos Tarokk
description: Húszashívásos Tarokk ('Call Twenty Tarot') is Hungary's national card game. 4 players. 42-card Tarot deck (from 54-card Austrian Tarock). Skíz(XXII)=highest, 22 trumps + suit cards. Declarer calls Trump XX to find secret partner. Talon exchange. Need 48+ of 94 card points. Bonuses for Trull, Pagát ultimo, Volát.

overview.description: Húszashívásos Tarokk ('Call Twenty Tarot') is Hungary's national card game. 4 players. 42-card Tarot deck (from 54-card Austrian Tarock). Skíz(XXII)=highest, 22 trumps + suit cards. Declarer calls Trump XX to find secret partner. Talon exchange. Need 48+ of 94 card points. Bonuses for Trull, Pagát ultimo, Volát.

history.origins: Húszashívásos tarokk was developed in the 19th century from Austrian Zwanzigerrufen (Call Twenty). It became the favourite game of the Hungarian establishment and was discouraged during the communist era due to its gentry associations; interest has revived since.
timeline: 19th century: developed in Hungary from Austrian Zwanzigerrufen (Call Twenty); became national card game.

setup.deck: 42 cards. 22 trumps (I-XXI + Skíz). 20 suit cards (K,Q,Rider,J + pip).

rules.objective: The declarer's team must take at least 48 of the 94 card points in tricks (more than half) to win the game.
rules.gameplay: Bid 3/2/1/Solo (talon cards taken). Call Trump XX = secret partner. Exchange from talon, discard. Follow suit, must trump if void. 9 tricks. Bonuses: Trull (all 3 honours), Pagát ultimo (win last with I), Volát (all tricks).

variations.emptyOverridesReason: No documented variants with distinct engine overrides; add when sources provide variant rules.

scoring.description: K=5, Q=4, R=3, J=2, others=1. Total=94. Need 48+. Double game=71+. Bonuses multiplied.
